findings.quote: 若两种方案在完成时间和退出率上出现可观察差异，且差异与安装或预算约束相关，则支持对应约束的决策影响假设
findings.reason: Task completion time/exit rate differences and correlation do not establish purchase decision effects without purchase/defer/cancel indicators and competing explanations. Global caveat does not constrain this local claim.
